updates.prompt: For standard 1000BASE-T channels on compliant Cat 5e and Cat 6a cabling, which two statements are true? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: Both categories specify 10GBASE-T over a full 100-meter channel.

options.label: B
options.text: Both support 1 Gigabit Ethernet.

options.label: C
options.text: Both have a maximum 1000BASE-T channel length of 55 meters.

options.label: D
options.text: Both support a 100-meter 1000BASE-T channel.

options.label: E
options.text: Both are specified to 500 MHz.

updates.explanation: B、D。符合布线要求的 Cat 5e 与 Cat 6a 都可支持 1000BASE-T 的 100 米信道。Cat 6a 额定至 500 MHz 并适合完整 100 米 10GBASE-T；不能因此把 Cat 5e 也归为该 10GBASE-T 规格。原 C 说两者能跑 55 米同样成立，现改为询问最大长度以消除歧义；55 米不是 1000BASE-T 频道上限。

review.finding: B、D。符合布线要求的 Cat 5e 与 Cat 6a 都可支持 1000BASE-T 的 100 米信道。Cat 6a 额定至 500 MHz 并适合完整 100 米 10GBA

updates.prompt: For a Cisco WLAN with Broadcast SSID enabled, which two statements about the SSID and its announcement are correct? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: The SSID is at most 32 octets long.

options.label: B
options.text: The SSID by itself determines the Wi-Fi data rate.

options.label: C
options.text: The SSID can only be used with a wireless controller.

options.label: D
options.text: The SSID is restricted to exactly one access point.

updates.prompt: Which two are benefits of RFC 1918 private IPv4 addressing in independently administered networks? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: Only private addresses can be subnetted hierarchically.

options.label: B
options.text: The same private address ranges can be reused in separate networks.

options.label: C
options.text: Internal addresses need not be advertised in the global Internet routing table.

options.label: D
options.text: Private addresses encrypt sensitive data inside the enterprise.

options.label: E
options.text: Private addressing alone securely encrypts traffic through an ISP.

updates.explanation: B、C。RFC 1918 地址可以在彼此独立的网络重复使用，通常不在全球互联网中作为公网前缀路由；网络互联时地址重叠仍需规划或转换。私网本身不加密、不保证安全；公有地址也可以分层划分。原 B 将节省维护成本表述成必然效果，现改为可验证的复用优势。

updates.prompt: An AP connects through an Ethernet access switch using a 2.5GBASE-T or 5GBASE-T link. Both ports explicitly support the required IEEE 802.3bz speed and the cable channel meets its specifications. Which two cabling categories among these can be used? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: Category 6A twisted-pair cable

options.label: B
options.text: 1000BASE-LX/LH optical transceiver

options.label: C
options.text: Category 5e twisted-pair cable

options.label: D
options.text: Category 3 twisted-pair cable

options.label: E
options.text: A telephone-only untwisted cable

updates.explanation: A、C。符合信道条件的 Cat 5e 和 Cat 6A 可用于支持 802.3bz 的 2.5G/5G 铜缆端口；实际距离、线缆质量和端口支持须核实。1000BASE-LX/LH 是 1G 光接口而非适用于此铜缆链路的线缆类别；Cat 3 和未绞合电话线不满足题设。原题将 10GBASE-T 物理层标准当线缆类别，并假设所有 10G 端口都支持 2.5G/5G，现明确端口与线缆前提。

review.finding: A、C。符合信道条件的 Cat 5e 和 Cat 6A 可用于支持 802.3bz 的 2.5G/5G 铜缆端口；实际距离、线缆质量和端口支持须核实。1000BASE-LX/LH
